entities.name: Victor A. Lundy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Victor Alfred Lundy was an American architect. An exemplar of modernist architecture, he was one of the leaders of the Sarasota School of Architecture. His Warm Mineral Springs Motel, outside Warm Mineral Springs, Florida, is listed in the National Register of Historic Places.
